name: @sengac/fspec-bridge
description: fspec bridge server — WebSocket relay hub and endpoint bridges for connecting fspec sessions to external clients (Telegram, mobile, custom apps)

scripts.start:server:bg: nohup npx tsx relay-server-cli.ts > server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > server.pid && echo 'Relay server started in background (PID saved to server.pid)'
scripts.stop:server: kill $(cat server.pid) 2>/dev/null && rm server.pid && echo 'Relay server stopped' || echo 'No running server found'
scripts.start:telegram:bg: nohup npx tsx telegram-endpoint.ts > telegram.log 2>&1 & echo $! > telegram.pid && echo 'Telegram bridge started in background (PID saved to telegram.pid)'
scripts.stop:telegram: kill $(cat telegram.pid) 2>/dev/null && rm telegram.pid && echo 'Telegram bridge stopped' || echo 'No running bridge found'
scripts.start:relay:bg: nohup npx tsx relay-endpoint.ts > relay.log 2>&1 & echo $! > relay.pid && echo 'Relay endpoint started in background (PID saved to relay.pid)'
scripts.stop:relay: kill $(cat relay.pid) 2>/dev/null && rm relay.pid && echo 'Relay endpoint stopped' || echo 'No running endpoint found'

author: rquast@sengac.com
